So `completion_only_loss: true` in all five configs is silently inert — prompt tokens are trained for BOTH SFT and DFT arms. This corrupts the load-bearing P1 SFT-vs-DFT estimand (DFT's `sg(π_θ)` reweight behaves differently on high-confidence prompt tokens than on completion tokens). Claude `code-review v1` explicitly stated this masking was correct; it is not.
